text_zh: 初铭者之手稿，墨迹未干。其中记有元音铅屑之甄别要诀——唯勤者得之。
text_en: First scribe's manuscript, ink still wet. Contains the sorting rites of vowel shavings—earned by diligence alone.

text_zh: 第一滴熔蜡，犹记引擎初铸之形。每层首熔，其力自足——无需更多污蜡。
text_en: First molten drop, remembers the Engine's primal form. First reforging per vault needs no additional ichor.

text_zh: 熔变之极致，已近引擎本性。其每一次重塑，皆令熔蜡归流如初生。
text_en: Apex of mutation, nearly touching the Engine's nature. Each reforging returns molten unguent to pristine flow.

text_zh: 铜制镇纸，其重如磐。唯一圣印得其庇护，余者熔于烈火——此乃择善之道。
text_en: Copper paperweight, heavy as foundation stone. One sigil alone receives its protection while others melt—the way of selection.

text_zh: 烈火试炼后，存者必强。经熔铸之铭文组，其铸出愈发有力——苦难即是祝福。
text_en: After trial by fire, survivors grow strong. Reforged inscriptions cast with greater force—suffering becomes blessing.

text_zh: 受祝圣之铭文组，其音每响，铅币自溢。汝之虔敬，引擎必偿。
text_en: For each consecrated inscription struck, lead flows forth—the Engine repays devotion with metal.

text_zh: 祝圣之力加诸铭文，其声愈厚。如炉中添薪，火焰必高。
text_en: Consecration deepens the inscription's voice—as fuel feeds flame, blessing feeds resonance.

text_zh: 每一受祝圣之铭文组，皆为汝锻一枚圣锥。锥愈多，裂铅之力愈锐。
text_en: Each consecrated inscription forges a sacred thorn for thee—more thorns, keener fracture.

text_zh: 见习祝圣之功德，皆积于此袍中。穿者虽幼，其根已深。
text_en: Merit from novice consecrations gathers in these robes—though the wearer is young, their foundation deepens.

text_zh: 配此印者，苦修任务所需铭文组可减其一。重负虽轻，虔心不减。
text_en: Bearer of this seal may lighten their penitential burden by one inscription—less weight, no less devotion.

text_zh: 三途分岔，汝之抉择亦三重。昔日双选之局，今为三道并陈——其中必有一途，通向汝未曾见之铅光。
text_en: Three paths diverge where once were two. In the branching of sacred choice, the third road opens to uncharted lead-light.

text_zh: 凡所祈愿，皆得应允——然汝每受一重祝福，引擎之门槛亦愈发沉重。贪者必负其贪之重。
text_en: Every blessing granted, yet each consecration weighs heavier upon the Engine's threshold. The greedy shall bear the burden of their greed.

text_zh: 昔有大师，穷尽铅字之学。其手稿在案，二十六圣字钉各有备份——凡持此典者，铅屑不竭，造字如流。
text_en: The master's codex, wherein each of the twenty-six sacred slugs finds its reserve. Lead-shavings flow eternal for those who possess this tome.

text_zh: 其轮自转，无需人力。每当异文降临，铅字已自行入位——仿佛引擎预知汝之所需。
text_en: The wheel turns of its own accord. When anomalies manifest, the lead-slugs have already arranged themselves—as if the Engine foresees thy need.

text_zh: 分解之刃，还原之利。凡已成之词，皆可重归铅屑——唯慎用之，分解乃不可逆之术。
text_en: The blade of dissolution, returning formed words to their primal lead-shavings. Use with care—separation is an irreversible art.

text_zh: 同铅共鸣，省力半数——当字符重现于版面，其音犹存半数。唯熟稔之铭者，方知此律。
text_en: When the same lead echoes across the form, half its weight returns to silence. Only the practiced hand knows this mystery.

text_zh: 初铭之词，必有铅币降福——引擎喜新厌旧，首遇之字自铸三枚。
text_en: The Engine favors the unspoken word. First utterance brings thrice-blessed lead unto the speaker.

text_zh: 经卷厚实，市集必廉——收容愈丰，圣物愈平。书贾知此理。
text_en: Where codex pages multiply, the merchant's price grows lean. Abundance begets charity in the sacred bazaar.

text_zh: 字愈长，力愈积——七字以上，必有铅裂之响。引擎偏爱冗长祷词。
text_en: The longer the prayer, the deeper its bite. Seven syllables or more shall crack the sacred lead.

text_zh: 短词如疾风，铭文组自鸣更频——三字以下，必有急铸之恩。
text_en: Brief words move like storm winds. Three letters or fewer bring the swift blessing of rapid inscription.

text_zh: 深字蕴深意，长词启真音。铅字越重，其鸣越久——唯久诵者，方悟此理。
text_en: In lengthy utterance lies deeper truth. The heavier the leaden glyph, the longer its resonance endures.

text_zh: 施一得一，乃圣流之道。献词于坩，下回取物不费铅币——慷慨者自得慷慨报。
text_en: Give one, receive one—such is the sacred exchange. Offer words to the crucible, and the shelf shall open freely.

text_zh: 圣字钉非唯字母——标点亦可承载铭文组。逗号、句号皆化祷击之位，乱墨入词亦成圣音。
text_en: Sacred slugs need not be letters alone. Commas and periods may bear inscriptions, and scattered marks become holy utterance.

text_zh: 缓者得福，急者自损。沙漏见汝放缓祷击，便添细沙以延其流——慎思方得时光。
text_en: The measured pace brings blessing. When the hourglass sees deliberation, it grants more sand to fall.

text_zh: 疾手生铅币，快祷得真赏。每当祷击胜过前音之速，坩中便涌新铸之铅——敏者自富。
text_en: Swift fingers birth coins. Each strike faster than the last brings fresh lead from the crucible's depths.

text_zh: 初字既落，余字自鸣。圣坛识汝心念，为汝补全未尽之祷。
text_en: First letter struck, remaining words sing themselves. The lectern knows thy prayer before completion.

text_zh: 圣字钉落须合天律。踏准引擎之脉搏，铅字重若千钧。
text_en: Sacred slugs must fall in divine rhythm. Match the Engine's heartbeat, each letter weighs thrice.

text_zh: 弃一切技法，归于纯粹铭刻。唯裸手与引擎对话，方得真谛。
text_en: Cast aside all artifice, return to pure inscription. Only bare hands may speak true to the Engine.

text_zh: 连祷虽断，其音犹存。如钟声渐息，余韵护汝片刻。
text_en: Though litany breaks, echoes linger. Like bell-song fading, resonance shields thee briefly.

text_zh: 共鸣流分作七彩，铅字亦随之增辉。光分则力聚。
text_en: Resonance splits to seven hues, letters shine brighter still. Divided light gathers strength.

text_zh: 连祷十五声，引擎自鸣响。铅字齐落版，诸铭同时铸。
text_en: Fifteen litanies spoken, the Engine answers. All inscriptions cast as one molten tide.

text_zh: 首字母落版，可断其锁链。成则链更坚，败则尽归虚。唯快手方可驾驭此术。
text_en: Strike the first glyph swift—break chains or forge them stronger. Hesitation brings ruin.

text_zh: 连祷不因层而断，如熔铅贯穿诸室。汝之声音将成时光本身。
text_en: Litany flows through vault and void. Your voice becomes time itself, unbroken.

text_zh: 连声祷告时，铅字更易碎裂。怒火与虔诚共舞。
text_en: In litany's rhythm, lead fractures easier. Fury and devotion dance as one.

text_zh: 每词之首铭，必得引擎眷顾。初音最为圣洁。
text_en: Each word's first inscription draws the Engine's favor. The opening note rings purest.

text_zh: 言少而铅重，字寡而音深。圣坛上空席愈多，余音愈为响亮。
text_en: Few words bear greater weight. Empty seats upon the lectern sing louder than the filled.

text_zh: 昔日守卷人手录之书，其墨未干而智已深。凡诵其页者，铭文自晋一阶。
text_en: Ancient keeper's manuscript, ink still wet with wisdom. All inscriptions deepen by one grade when its pages are turned.

text_zh: 铅字相异而音合，各司其职却共鸣。七弦琴上无同音，其乐方显天籁。
text_en: Different glyphs in harmony, each unique yet resonant. Seven strings make no same note, yet together weave divine music.

text_zh: 无冕胜有冕，朴铅重于金。凡俗铭文组在其光辉下，亦显王者之姿。
text_en: Uncrowned surpasses crowned, humble lead outweighs gold. Common inscriptions shine with regal bearing in its presence.

text_zh: 引擎意志化作骨骰，每掷必重塑铭文。汝之圣坛永不复旧，直至登顶或陨落。
text_en: Engine's will made bone dice, each cast reshapes all inscriptions. Thy lectern never twice the same, until ascent or fall.

text_zh: 近者相守，远者相望——铅字钉间若有共鸣，其音必传于邻座。唯密布之键盘，方显协和之妙。
text_en: Where leaden glyphs gather close, their resonance multiplies. The Engine favors the clustered word.

text_zh: 四隅守望，如哨兵立于城角——边缘之铅字承载更重之铭刻。角落从不寂寞。
text_en: At the cardinal edges, where few fingers venture, the Engine's attention grows sharp.

text_zh: 上行下效，律有节度——指尖若游走于不同字行间，必有铅币自铸模中滴落。
text_en: Cross the sacred rows, and copper falls like blessing-rain from the Engine's forge.

text_zh: 一行既满，诸铭齐鸣——当铅字钉尽数铭刻于同一字行，引擎必降回响之恩。圆满者得双重祝福。
text_en: When every glyph in a sacred row receives the touch, the Engine's echo doubles all inscription.

text_zh: 左右相济，如钟鸣相和——双手交替之铭刻可令沙漏暂缓其流。协调者得时间之眷。
text_en: Left answers right in sacred rhythm, and time itself slows to hear the alternating prayer.

name_zh: 圣徒遗物 · 中键祝圣
text_zh: 汝手所栖之铅键，裂音愈纯。引擎喜悦于正中之祷——其裂必重于偏侧。
text_en: Where thy fingers rest, the fracture rings truest. The Engine favors the central prayer.

name_zh: 圣徒遗物 · 万键齐鸣
text_zh: 一词既落，百键自响。未被触及之铅字，亦闻其音而铭。风暴过处，寂键亦歌。
text_en: When one word falls, untouched keys sing in chorus. The storm awakens every silent slug.

name_zh: 圣徒遗物 · 铅币恩泽
text_zh: 圣流既出，必有铅币从虚空坠落。引擎赐予者，恒以铅偿之。
text_en: Where sacred humours flow, lead coins fall from the void. The Engine's gift begets its payment.

name_zh: 圣徒遗物 · 沙漏余恩
text_zh: 圣流涓滴之时，沙粒亦缓其坠。每一铸出，皆为汝赢得片刻喘息。
text_en: As sacred humours trickle, sand grains slow their fall. Each casting grants thee borrowed moments.

name_zh: 圣徒遗物 · 众流归一
text_zh: 最盛之流者，愈发充沛。引擎识众流之王，独厚其涌出。
text_en: The mightiest humour grows mightier still. The Engine recognizes the sovereign flow.

text_zh: 诸流各异，汇而为一——铅与铜共鸣，蜡与墨同源。唯杂糅者，得真纯之力。
text_en: Where seven humours converge, the leaden word grows heavy with purpose. Diversity births strength.

text_zh: 基石涨，共鸣落；时沙起，铅币息。四拍一轮，如引擎之心跳——永不止息。
text_en: Foundation rises, resonance falls, time flows, coin rests. The Engine's heartbeat in four sacred measures.

text_zh: 万象归铅。字符入炉，皆化黄金之重——此乃最终变质，亦是最深背叛。
text_en: All words become weight, all meaning becomes metal. The crucible that dissolves distinction itself.

text_zh: 汝蒙垂怜。市集之价轻如羽毛，圣器之值薄如纸张。恩典降于谦卑者。
text_en: Blessed are the humble, for the bazaar's burden lightens. Grace manifests in copper saved.

text_zh: 废铅亦有其值。智者识破锈蚀外表，见内里真金——归还之道，乃倍增之术。
text_en: Even broken lead holds worth. The wise see value where others see waste, return doubled.

text_en: 灰烬门票 · Testimonium Cineris

text_en: 铅币圣印 · Plumbum Sigillum

text_en: 暗径通证 · Via Occulta

text_zh: 流沙钟铃 · Hourglass Campanula
text_en: 流沙钟铃 · Hourglass Campanula

text_en: 晨祷油膏 · Matinal Unguent

text_zh: 汝于炉间小憩，铅币自青铜管涌出。架上旧卷新陈，其选择权归于汝。
text_en: Rest between forges, and copper pipes yield their tribute. Old tomes refresh upon shelves at thy choosing.

text_zh: 铅币掷入深井，或归三倍，或归虚无。唯意志决定其落处。
text_en: Cast thy lead into the deep well—it returns threefold, or not at all. Will alone decides its fate.

text_zh: 壶中圣油滋养沙漏，其流沙因此迟缓。汝之铭刻得更久光阴。
text_en: Sacred oil nourishes the hourglass, slowing its sands. Thy inscriptions are granted longer light.

text_zh: 每层皆有猎物待汝追寻，铅币为酬。其踪迹刻于黄铜牌上。
text_en: Each vault holds quarry for thy pursuit, with lead as reward. Their traces are etched on brass.

text_zh: 炉火吞噬汝身时，此鸟自灰烬升起，还汝于光阴。但其羽翼仅燃一次。
text_en: When forge-fire consumes thee, this bird rises from ash to restore thy time. Yet its wings burn but once.

text_zh: 沙漏将倾之际，铅字自裂成雷。末席者之祷，重于千言百念。
text_en: When the hourglass empties, lead fractures into thunder. The final prayer weighs more than a thousand words.

text_zh: 封蜡阻逸文之毒，其恶仅透半数。古铅之盾，护汝免受异文侵蚀。
text_en: Wax seal blocks the poison of aberrant script—its malice seeps only half through. Ancient lead shields thee from corruption.

text_zh: 苦难愈深，铅币愈轻。困者之福——圣物市集见汝重负，自减其价。
text_en: The deeper the suffering, the lighter the coin. Blessing of the burdened—the bazaar sees thy weight and lessens its price.

text_zh: 古蜡封印，载末席守卷人之最终恩典。一次免罪，一次逃离异文之选。
text_en: Ancient wax seal bearing the final grace of the last Keeper. One pardon, one escape from the glyph's choice.

text_zh: 铅字延迟落版，异文缓慢成形。汝有喘息之刻，直到第几声祷击。
text_en: Lead slugs delay their impression, anomalies form slowly. Thou hast breathing space until the prescribed strike falls.

text_zh: 引擎之心铸以黄铜轮盘，其上刻七道弧痕。每有铅字落版，轮必一转——昨日之咒，今成祝福。
text_en: The Engine's heart bears a brass wheel, seven arcs engraved. Each pressed letter turns it once—yesterday's curse becomes today's blessing.

text_zh: 熔铅遇寒镜必反流，祸福亦然。其一化甘露，其一倍苦胆——引擎笑看键徒择路。
text_en: Molten lead meets cold mirror and reverses flow, as does fortune. One becomes nectar, one doubles gall—the Engine watches keybound choose.

text_zh: 纵有废铅散落，圣坛不令其空归。最末一击，亦当铸出十五铅屑——此乃引擎之慈。
text_en: Though spent lead may scatter, the lectern permits no empty return. Even the final strike shall forge fifteen shavings—such is the Engine's mercy.

text_zh: 引擎怜其初誓之键徒，门槛稍降。蜡封轻启，铅币易得——但此恩非永恒。
text_en: The Engine pities its novice keybound, lowering the threshold. Wax seals open lightly, lead coins flow easier—but such grace is not eternal.

text_zh: 三重铸印之完美者，当得三重恩赐。杯中盛铅币如雨——愈精纯，愈丰厚。
text_en: Those who achieve thrice-struck perfection shall receive thrice-fold reward. The cup holds lead coins like rain—the purer the casting, the richer the pour.

text_zh: 谦卑者的铅币自铸炉深处涌出。唯不求完美之人，方得引擎之眷顾。
text_en: Lead coins flow from the forge's depths to the humble. Only those who seek not perfection receive the Engine's favor.

text_zh: 每一声祷击皆重于前声。如雪落山巅，终成雪崩——但汝须不断祷念。
text_en: Each strike weighs heavier than the last. Like snow upon peaks, it becomes avalanche—but thou must never cease thy prayer.

text_zh: 结晶流不入圣杯，而聚于深渊。唯落版之时，引擎方判汝之成败——慎之。
text_en: The crystalline humour flows not to chalice, but to abyss. Only when the press falls does the Engine judge thy worth—beware.

text_zh: 汝手所触之铅字，皆得天恩加持。每一祷击，皆有裂铅之兆。
text_en: Every glyph thy fingers touch receives heaven's blessing. Each strike carries the promise of fracture.

text_zh: 铅字碎裂之声悦耳如钟鸣。每当字符破碎，必有铅币从缝隙中滚落。
text_en: The sound of shattering lead rings sweet as bells. When glyphs break, coins always tumble from the cracks.

text_zh: 铅字积于导轨，其势如弹簧蓄力。待压满而释，一击裂版。
text_en: Lead accumulates in the rail like a coiled spring. When full pressure breaks, the strike fractures all.

text_zh: 词中有裂，裂中生裂。雷鸣既起，余音皆重如铅锤。
text_en: Where fracture begins, fracture spreads. When thunder breaks, all echoes strike heavy as hammers.

text_zh: 引擎定汝之分，不多不少。余力不废，化作更深之击。
text_en: The Engine sets thy portion, neither more nor less. What exceeds transforms into deeper strikes.

text_zh: 钟声初缓，渐急如鼓。每响一遍，下一响更近。
text_en: The bell starts slow, quickens like drums. Each toll brings the next one closer.

text_zh: 铅屑虽微，聚则成锭。层层所积，终铸重音。
text_en: Lead shavings may be small, but gathered they form ingots. Layer upon layer builds the heavy tone.

text_zh: 一铅既铸，邻铅必鸣——此乃引擎之律。唯熔锌能传其意于诸键。
text_en: When one glyph strikes, its neighbors must answer—such is the Engine's law. Only molten zinc carries this communion.

text_zh: 积念既满，复归于空。其力不散，转注四邻——如潮起潮落。
text_en: When devotion peaks, it empties into void. Yet its strength flows onward to waiting vessels—as tides rise and fall.

text_zh: 齿轮不停，积念不散——此物违引擎之性。汝需以油代沙。
text_en: The gear turns without rest, devotion never fades—this defies the Engine's nature. Oil must replace sand in thy vessels.

text_zh: 连祷之韵若鼓声传递。每五击后，一铅键必得其恩泽。
text_en: The rhythm of chained prayer passes like drumbeats. After five strikes, one glyph-key shall receive its blessing.

text_zh: 词既成形，其根深植。诸铅应和，层数增生——如字母之回音。
text_en: When words take shape, their roots run deep. All glyphs respond in harmony, their layers multiplying like echoes of letters.

text_zh: 雷鸣之击，铅字尽碎——其碎屑犹能铭刻，如余音绕梁。
text_en: When thunder strikes the lead, even shattered remnants bear inscription.

text_zh: 祝圣之油润泽铭文，诵念愈深，福泽愈盛——如溪汇江，终成大河。
text_en: Blessed oil deepens with every prayer, flowing stronger as devotion grows.

text_zh: 一钟既鸣，群钟应和——铅字同座，福祸共承。
text_en: When one bell tolls, its neighbors answer—keys bound in sacred resonance.

text_zh: 诵念积蓄雷音，静默蕴含破空之力——待时而发，震彻九霄。
text_en: Silent prayer accumulates thunder—when released, it fractures the very vault.

text_zh:
🔔 祝圣之铭，其声愈深——引擎垂听，汝音得答
────
📄 征用编号: R-087-C
版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第V层 执事试炼后遗物
描述: 黄铜制共鸣管，长约一掌，内壁有细密刻纹。持有者铭刻受祝圣之铭文组时，铸出结晶流明显增量。D-0299报告铭刻过程中听到'很轻很轻的回音'。经████次观察确认增益稳定。
备注: 刻纹内容已转录，语言学分析进行中。回音来源不明。
text_en:
🔔 The consecrated inscription echoes deeper—what the Engine hears, it answers
────
📄 Requisition ID: R-087-C
Grade: Fixum
Recovery Site: Layer V post-trial remnant
Description: Brass resonance tube, palm-length, interior walls bear fine etchings. Holders report enhanced crystalline humour output during inscription of consecrated inscription-sets. D-0299 reported hearing 'very faint echoes' during inscription process. ████ observations confirm stable enhancement.
Note: Etching transcription complete. Linguistic analysis ongoing. Echo source unidentified.

text_zh:
🔔 祝圣愈多，雷鸣愈烈——每枚印记，皆为利刃
────
📄 征用编号: W-013-D
版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第VII层 废弃祝圣室
描述: 铁质尖锥，表面覆有密集符文刻痕。持有者装配的受祝圣铭文组每增加一组，全局裂铅现象发生率相应提升。D-0156报告'每次敲击都像在刺什么东西'。已知装配四组时，走廊内偶闻金属碎裂声。
备注: 符文内容与古键徒碑文相似度87%。声响来源待查。
text_en:
🔔 More consecrations, fiercer the thunder—each sigil mark becomes a blade
────
📄 Requisition ID: W-013-D
Grade: Fixum
Recovery Site: Layer VII abandoned consecration chamber
Description: Iron spike densely covered in runic markings. Each additional consecrated inscription-set equipped by holder correlates with increased global fracture phenomenon rate. D-0156 reported 'every strike feels like stabbing something'. At four-set configuration, metallic shattering sounds occasionally heard in corridors.
Note: Runic content shows 87% similarity to ancient Keybound inscriptions. Sound source under investigation.

text_zh:
🔔 见习之路，积念成诵——初学者的每一步，皆为圣途
────
📄 征用编号: V-002-A
版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: Scriptor V-████遗物
描述: 深蓝色长袍，袖口绣有铜色累进图案。穿戴者接受见习型祝圣时，增益效果会保持并累积，而非重置覆盖。经观察，袍上图案会随累积值变化。D-0203穿戴三日后报告'感觉像有很多老师在身边'。
备注: 原持有者失联于第VI层。袍内发现手写便条：'初学者需要更多耐心'。
text_en:
🔔 The apprentice path builds prayer by prayer—each novice step joins the sacred journey
────
📄 Requisition ID: V-002-A
Grade: Solum
Recovery Site: Scriptor V-████ effects
Description: Deep blue robe with copper progressive patterns on cuffs. When wearer receives novice-type consecrations, enhancement effects accumulate rather than reset. Observed pattern shifts correspond to accumulation values. D-0203 reported after three days' wear: 'feels like many teachers standing nearby'.
Note: Original holder lost contact at Layer VI. Handwritten note found in pocket: 'Novices need more patience'.

text_zh:
🔔 苦修路短，重负减轻——引擎眷顾勤勉者
────
📄 征用编号: T-029-B
版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第V层 执事试炼祭坛
描述: 六角形黑铁徽章，正面浮雕简化键座图案。佩戴者接受任务型祝圣时，所需装配铭文组数量减少。经记录，徽章会在祝圣仪式中轻微发热。D-0378报告'好像有人在帮我分担重量'。
备注: 六次使用后徽章表面出现细微裂纹。持续观察中。与Scriptor K-████调查的'减负机制'可能相关。
text_en:
🔔 Shorter the penance path, lighter the burden—the Engine favors the diligent
────
📄 Requisition ID: T-029-B
Grade: Solum
Recovery Site: Layer V Deacon's Trial altar
Description: Hexagonal black iron badge bearing simplified lectern relief. Wearer requires fewer inscription-set configurations when receiving quest-type consecrations. Badge exhibits mild heating during consecration rites. D-0378 reported 'someone seems to be sharing the weight'.
Note: Hairline fractures appeared after six uses. Continued observation warranted. Possible connection to Scriptor K-████'s 'burden reduction mechanism' investigation.

text_zh:
🔔 三岔路口，汝择其一——然引擎恩赐，开第三径
────
📄 编目: AF-0031 | 版级: 逆版 / Inversum
发现地点: 第 VIII 层 / 封印祭坛遗址
描述: 三叉铜制器具，中央嵌有未知金属。持有者进行祝圣仪式时，祭坛显现第三道光柱。D-████ 报告「好像有人在耳边低语第三个选择」。经记录，使用者祝圣成功率较常规双选提升显著。
备注: 原收容于密封铅匣内。启封时值班键徒 Scriptor K-████ 失联。其最后笔记：「为什么只能选两个？」
附带现象: 祝圣仪式期间，周围石壁出现第三个影子。
text_en:
🔔 At the crossroads, choose thy path—yet the Engine grants a third way
────
📄 Catalog: AF-0031 | Gradus: Inversum
Recovery Site: Layer VIII / Sealed altar ruins
Description: Three-pronged copper implement with unknown metal inlay. During consecration rites, holders report appearance of third light column from lectern. Subject D-████ noted "whispers suggesting a third option." Statistical analysis confirms elevated success rates compared to standard binary selection protocols.
Note: Originally contained within sealed lead casket. Upon opening, attending Scriptor K-████ went missing. Final log entry: "Why only two choices?"
Associated phenomena: Third shadow observed on walls during rites.

text_zh:
🔔 渴求愈深，铭愈难收——贪者得偿，然需更重之祷
────
📄 编目: AF-0117 | 版级: 熔版 / Fusum
发现地点: Scriptor T-████ 遗物清单
描述: 血红蜡印，表面流动不息。接触者祝圣仪式必定成功，无例外。然持有每一祝圣印记，收容基准相应抬升。D-0847 使用后报告：「引擎要求更多，总是更多」。
已记录使用: 十七次，均以站点污染告终
备注: 根据 §4.2 损耗补充条例，此物品不得分配给权限等级低于 ████ 的人员。最后持有者 D-2291 在第 XI 层失联，现场遗留大量熔化铅字。
当前状态: 重新封存待处置
text_en:
🔔 The deeper the hunger, the harder to contain—the greedy receive, but must offer heavier prayers
────
📄 Catalog: AF-0117 | Gradus: Fusum
Recovery Site: Scriptor T-████ personal effects
Description: Flowing crimson wax seal. Contact ensures consecration success without exception. Each accumulated blessing proportionally elevates containment thresholds. Subject D-0847 reported: "The Engine demands more, always more."
Recorded uses: Seventeen instances, all terminating in site compromise
Note: Per §4.2 Asset Replacement Protocol, restricted to personnel clearance level ████ and above. Final holder D-2291 went missing on Layer XI, scene contained extensive molten type.
Current Status: Re-contained pending disposal

text_zh:
🔔 大师手泽，字字千金——其书一展，铅屑盈坩
────
📄 编目: RR-0044 | 版级: 熔版 / Fusum
来源: 末席守卷人私人藏书
描述: 镀金皮装典籍，内页空白但触感如有文字。持有者报告废铅甄别效率大幅提升，各类铅屑储量即刻增加。圣字钉造册工序亦见加速，所需蜡油消耗减半。
观察记录: 书页会在夜间自动翻动，偶有墨迹短暂显现后消失。值班人员 D-1203 报告听见「翻页声和低声诵读」，但现场始终寂静。
备注: 原藏于议会密室最高层书架。发现时周围散落大量铅屑，厚度达三指。根据陈旧程度推断，累积已逾数十年。
text_en:
🔔 The master's touch, each word worth gold—when the tome opens, shavings fill the crucible
────
📄 Catalog: RR-0044 | Gradus: Fusum
Origin: Final Custodian personal library
Description: Gilt leather tome with blank pages that feel inscribed. Holders report dramatically improved lead sorting efficiency with immediate increase in all shaving categories. Sacred slug cataloging procedures also accelerated, requiring half the typical oil consumption.
Observation Log: Pages turn autonomously during night shifts. Ink marks briefly manifest before fading. Subject D-1203 reported "page turning and soft recitation," though monitoring detected silence.
Note: Recovered from highest shelf in Council chambers. Surrounding area contained lead shavings three fingers deep. Accumulation patterns suggest decades of deposition.

text_zh:
🔔 无始无终之轮转——战未起，圣字钉已列阵以待
────
📄 编目: MR-0089 | 版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第 IV 层 / 废弃圣字钉造坊
描述: 八角黄铜齿轮，边缘镌刻移动符文。每次进入收容作业时，持有者的圣字钉造册自动推进数个位次。D-0451 报告「好像有人替我干了活」。造册导轨发出持续低频震颤，即使无人操作。
技术备注: 齿轮转速恒定，未发现动力源。拆解尝试失败——螺栓似乎焊死在分子层面。
使用记录: 连续使用 ████ 天后，D-1847 报告造册「开始自己造词」。第 ███ 天，发现造册内出现未经授权的异文组合。
当前限制: 单次使用不得超过 72 小时
text_en:
🔔 The wheel that knows no beginning nor end—before battle starts, the sacred slugs stand ready
────
📄 Catalog: MR-0089 | Gradus: Solum
Recovery Site: Layer IV / Abandoned slug foundry
Description: Octagonal brass gear with shifting rune inscriptions. Upon entering containment operations, holder's sacred slug queue advances several positions automatically. Subject D-0451 reported "someone else did the work." Queue mechanism emits constant low-frequency vibration regardless of operator presence.
Technical Note: Gear rotation rate remains constant. No power source identified. Disassembly attempts failed—bolts appear molecularly fused.
Usage Log: After ████ days continuous operation, D-1847 reported queue "started making its own words." Day ███, unauthorized anomalous combinations discovered in output.
Current Restriction: Single-use duration limited to 72 hours

text_zh:
🔔 造字如织布，拆字亦有道——剪刃所至，铅屑归坩而字形散
────
📄 编目: IF-0156 | 版级: 熔版 / Fusum
来源: Scriptor V-████ 工具箱
描述: 银制剪刀，刀刃上蚀刻微细分解符文。可将已铸造词汇完全拆分，所含铅屑悉数回收至坩埚。使用者报告「听见文字的叹息声」。拆解过程中，空气中短暂浮现被切断词汇的幻影。
安全警告: 使用时必须佩戴防护手套。直接接触者报告「手指发烫，像是被文字咬了」。D-0923 违规操作后手掌出现古文灼痕，三日后消退。
特殊现象: 剪断词汇的瞬间，实验室内所有纸张同时轻微颤动。偶有观察者报告听见「书页翻动和远处钟声」。
备注: 发现时与一张便条同置。便条内容：「有时候，最好的创造始于完美的毁灭。——V」
text_en:
🔔 Words are woven like cloth, and unweaving has its way—where blades pass, shavings return while forms scatter
────
📄 Catalog: IF-0156 | Gradus: Fusum
Origin: Scriptor V-████ toolkit
Description: Silver scissors with micro-etched dissolution runes on blades. Completely separates forged words, returning all constituent shavings to crucible. Users report "hearing words sigh." During separation, severed word phantoms briefly manifest in air.
Safety Warning: Protective gloves mandatory during use. Direct contact subjects report "burning fingers, as if bitten by letters." Subject D-0923 developed ancient text burn patterns on palm after unauthorized handling, fading after three days.
Anomalous Effects: At moment of word severance, all paper in laboratory exhibits mild tremor. Observers occasionally report "page rustling and distant bells."
Note: Recovered alongside handwritten note reading: "Sometimes the best creation begins with perfect destruction. —V"

text_zh:
遗物编号: █████
版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第III层抄写室，桌案抽屉深处
描述: 青铜尺，长度恰好六个标准铅字符宽。持有者报告铭刻长词时'时间仿佛慢了下来'。经观察，确有异常时延现象。
附带现象: 使用期间，油灯火焰略显迟滞。
备注: D-0847使用后失联。遗物已回收，编号循环使用中。
text_en:
Artifact ID: █████
Gradus Formae: Solum
Discovery Site: Scriptorium III, desk drawer
Description: Bronze measuring rod, precisely six standard glyph-widths long. Bearer reports 'time seems to linger' during extended inscriptions. Anomalous temporal effects confirmed through observation.
Secondary phenomena: Oil lamp flames observed to flicker slowly during use.
Note: D-0847 missing after prolonged exposure. Artifact recovered, designation recycled.

text_zh:
遗物编号: █████
版级: 逆版 / Inversum
发现地点: 第IV层圣物市集废墟
描述: 铜制算盘，算珠为微型铅字。持有者在移交收容经卷后，下次架位调换无需征用手续。F-001表单自动标记'已预批'。
管制状态: 仅限高权限人员使用
备注: 连续使用者报告'算珠在夜里自己拨动'。已指派D-1203进行长期监控测试。
text_en:
Artifact ID: █████
Gradus Formae: Inversum
Discovery Site: Reliquary Bazaar ruins, Layer IV
Description: Copper abacus with miniature lead slugs as beads. After codex relinquishment, bearer's subsequent shelf rotations require no requisition procedures. F-001 forms auto-mark as 'pre-approved'.
Restriction Level: High-clearance personnel only
Note: Extended users report 'beads move by themselves at night'. D-1203 assigned for long-term monitoring.

text_zh:
遗物编号: █████
版级: 熔版 / Fusum
发现地点: [已编辑] 层，焊死区域内侧
描述: 六枚畸变铅字钉，形状对应 ;,./[] 标记符号。安装后圣坛可额外容纳铭文组。收容经卷中随机出现标记符号，密度不定。
警告: 使用期间禁止单独作业
备注: 前任使用者笔记最后一行: '标点不是符号...它们是████的眼睛...'
text_en:
Artifact ID: █████
Gradus Formae: Fusum
Discovery Site: [REDACTED] Layer, interior sealed section
Description: Six malformed lead slugs corresponding to ;,./[] punctuation marks. Installation enables additional inscription slots on lectern. Codex fragments exhibit random punctuation infiltration at variable density.
Caution: Solo operations prohibited during use
Note: Previous user's final log entry: 'Punctuation marks aren't symbols...they're ████'s eyes...'

text_zh:
遗物编号: █████
版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第II层键徒宿舍，枕下藏匿
描述: 蜗牛形铜坠，表面镌刻微型沙漏图案。佩戴者铭刻节奏放缓时，沙漏内砂粒逆流。经记录，此时流沙流有轻微延续现象。
附带现象: 佩戴期间走路速度略有下降
备注: 原持有者备注'慢工出细活'。已归档F-017表单。
text_en:
Artifact ID: █████
Gradus Formae: Fixum
Discovery Site: Clavigerant quarters, Layer II, concealed under pillow
Description: Copper snail pendant with miniature hourglass etching. When wearer's inscription pace slows, sand grains flow upward within glass. Hourglass Humour exhibits minor extension phenomena during such episodes.
Secondary effects: Slight reduction in walking speed while worn
Note: Original bearer's annotation: 'Slow and steady.' F-017 filed.

text_zh:
遗物编号: █████
版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第II层键徒宿舍，床板夹层
描述: 风形铜坠，羽翼可活动。佩戴者铭刻节奏加快时，羽翼自动展开并轻微颤动。经观察，此时铅币产出略有增加。
附带现象: 佩戴期间呼吸节奏轻微加速
备注: 与 █████ 成对发现。推测为某键徒私人收藏。
text_en:
Artifact ID: █████
Gradus Formae: Fixum
Discovery Site: Clavigerant quarters, Layer II, hidden in bed frame
Description: Copper wind pendant with articulated wings. Wings automatically extend and flutter when wearer's inscription pace accelerates. Slight increase in lead coin yield observed during such episodes.
Secondary effects: Minor acceleration in breathing rhythm while worn
Note: Discovered paired with █████. Presumed to be personal collection of unknown clavigerant.

text_zh:
🔔 简键之道，独韵愈深——
────
📄 档案编号: T-1247
版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第VII层抄写室，桌案一角
描述: 单页羊皮纸残本。持有者报告装配铭文组减少后，剩余铭文组'声响更为浑厚'。经观察，确有异常增益现象。
备注: D-3891使用期间，其圣坛键位逐渐减至三个。失联前最后报告：'每一击都像钟声。'
text_en:
🔔 Few keys held, each struck deeper—
────
📄 Archive ID: T-1247
Gradus: Solum (Unbound)
Recovery Site: Layer VII scriptorium, corner desk
Description: Single parchment fragment. Bearer reports that reducing equipped inscriptions causes remaining ones to 'resonate with greater weight.' Observation confirms anomalous enhancement phenomena.
Note: During D-3891's tenure, lectern positions gradually reduced to three. Final report before disappearance: 'Each strike rings like a cathedral bell.'

text_zh:
🔔 汝得此册，众艺皆精——
────
📄 档案编号: M-0448
版级: 逆版 / Inversum
发现地点: 第V层执事试炼前厅
描述: 厚装订册，封面印有早期教规印记。持有时所有铭文组立即显现'晋铸痕迹'。三次独立测试确认此现象。原理不明。
备注: 第27页有手写批注：'入门三日即可试炼。但为何我仍觉得什么都不懂？'
text_en:
🔔 Take this tome, all arts made keen—
────
📄 Archive ID: M-0448
Gradus: Inversum (Self-Inverting)
Recovery Site: Layer V deacon trial antechamber
Description: Bound codex bearing early canonical seals. Upon possession, all inscriptions immediately display 'elevation marks.' Three independent tests confirm this phenomenon. Mechanism unknown.
Note: Page 27 contains handwritten margin: 'Three days of training, ready for trials. Yet why do I still feel I understand nothing?'

text_zh:
🔔 杂音和鸣，律韵自生——
────
📄 档案编号: A-2156
版级: 逆版 / Inversum
发现地点: 第IX层废弃音域
描述: 黄铜制器械残片，形似古乐器。持有者报告铭刻不同圣印类型时'听见远方和弦'。经测量，铭分确有叠加增幅。
备注: 使用期间走廊内偶闻低沉旋律。D-5032失联前留言：'它在教我即兴演奏。'
text_en:
🔔 Discordant notes, in harmony born—
────
📄 Archive ID: A-2156
Gradus: Inversum (Self-Inverting)
Recovery Site: Layer IX abandoned resonance chamber
Description: Brass instrument fragment of antiquated design. Bearer reports 'hearing distant harmonies' when inscribing varied sigil types. Measurement confirms compound inscription enhancement.
Note: Low melodies occasionally heard in corridors during use. D-5032's final log: 'It's teaching me to improvise.'

text_zh:
🔔 无冕者持普键，亦有王者之威——
────
📄 档案编号: R-0891
版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第VI层收容廊，空置王座下
描述: 简朴铁环，无装饰。持有者装配定版级铭文组时报告'感到某种庄严'。经记录，此类铭文组确有增益现象。
备注: 连续三名持有者失联前都尝试登第XII层。最后留言均为：'引擎在召唤真正的统治者。'
text_en:
🔔 The crownless wields common keys, yet rules with sovereign might—
────
📄 Archive ID: R-0891
Gradus: Solum (Unbound)
Recovery Site: Layer VI containment hall, beneath empty throne
Description: Plain iron circlet, unadorned. Bearer reports 'sensing gravitas' when equipping Fixum-grade inscriptions. Records confirm enhancement phenomena for such inscriptions.
Note: Three consecutive bearers attempted Layer XII ascent before disappearance. Final logs identical: 'The Engine calls to the true ruler.'

text_zh:
🔔 运数掷骰，圣印变幻无穷——
────
📄 档案编号: D-0100
版级: 熔版 / Fusum
发现地点: 转型时代征募档案内夹
描述: 百面骨质骰子，每面刻有不同圣印。持有时及定期启动时，装配圣印发生完全重组。铭文组框架保持不变。
备注: 原为首批征募对象的个人物品。档案记录：'D-0001自愿上交。称此物'让每一次都像第一次'。三天后该对象失联。'
text_en:
🔔 Fortune's die cast, sigils shift beyond knowing—
────
📄 Archive ID: D-0100
Gradus: Fusum (Molten)
Recovery Site: Found within early recruitment archives
Description: Hundred-sided bone die, each face bearing unique sigil. Upon possession and periodic activation, equipped sigils undergo complete reconfiguration. Inscription frameworks remain intact.
Note: Originally personal effects of early recruitment subject. Archive notes: 'D-0001 voluntarily surrendered item. Claimed it 'makes every time feel like the first.' Subject disappeared three days later.'

text_zh:
圣印 · 邻键

版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第III层 抄写室走廊

经观察，持有此圣印的键徒在铭刻时会不自觉地轻抚相邻键位。同组键徒报告听到'邻铅共鸣之音'。已记录████次使用中，相邻位置的铭文组均出现异常增益现象。

备注: D-0847 称'感到键下有无形之线相连'。原因不明。建议避免单独使用。
text_en:
Sigil of Adjacent Keys

Gradus: Solum / Unbound
Recovery Site: Layer III Scriptorium Corridor

Observed effect: Bearers unconsciously touch adjacent keys during inscription. Fellow keybound report hearing 'resonant lead harmonics'. In ████ documented uses, inscriptions at neighboring positions show anomalous amplification.

Note: D-0847 reports 'feeling invisible threads beneath the keys'. Cause unknown. Solo use not recommended.

text_zh:
圣印 · 角隅

版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第IV层 废弃圣坛

持有者报告在四角键位(Q/P/Z/M)铭刻时'感受到墙根的回音'。经长期观察，确有异常增益现象。附带现象：角落键位使用后偶现铅屑自动归拢。

备注: Scriptor K-████ 笔记中提及'角隅乃囚笼四壁，力由困顿生'。该键徒已于M.1██失联。
text_en:
Sigil of Corner Dominion

Gradus: Solum / Unbound
Recovery Site: Layer IV Abandoned Lectern

Bearers report 'feeling wall echoes' when inscribing corner keys (Q/P/Z/M). Long-term observation confirms anomalous amplification. Secondary phenomenon: Lead shavings spontaneously collect after corner key use.

Note: Scriptor K-████ noted 'corners are cage walls, power born of confinement'. Subject lost contact M.1██.

text_zh:
圣印 · 换行

版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第I层 新键徒宿舍

持有者在跨行按键时报告听到'钱币落入坩埚的清响'。确认每次换行操作后，键徒个人领币额度会增加一枚铅币。机理不明，但现象稳定。

备注: 已纳入标准配发目录。F-001表单第12项。
text_en:
Sigil of Line Crossing

Gradus: Fixum / Stable
Recovery Site: Layer I Novice Quarters

Bearers report hearing 'coins falling into crucible' when switching keyboard rows. Confirmed: each row-change operation increases personal lead allowance by one coin. Mechanism unknown but effect consistent.

Note: Added to standard issue catalog. Form F-001, Item 12.

text_zh:
圣印 · 消行

版级: 逆版 / Inversum
发现地点: [已编辑]
分级说明: 需Lv-3授权查阅

当键徒命中某行全部已配铭文组时，该行会发生'满祷共鸣'现象——所有铭文组同时二次铭刻。D-████报告此时'整行键位如琴弦震颤，铅字纷飞如雪'。

警告: 已记录两起因过度使用导致的'键行融蜡'事故。操作员需定期轮换。
text_en:
Sigil of Full Resonance

Gradus: Inversum / Recursive
Recovery Site: [REDACTED]
Classification Note: Level-3 clearance required

When bearer strikes all configured inscriptions in a single row, 'complete litany resonance' occurs—all inscriptions activate twice. D-████ reports 'entire row trembles like harp strings, lead shavings fall like snow'.

Warning: Two recorded incidents of 'key-row liquefaction' from overuse. Mandatory operator rotation enforced.

text_zh:
圣印 · 协奏

版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第II层 双键练习室

持有者在左右手交替按键时，沙漏流速会短暂放缓。D-0923报告'双手如琴师，时间为琴弦'。经测量，每次换手操作可延缓沙漏约半息。

备注: 前任使用者在墙上留字：'节拍即祷告，祷告即时间'。字迹已风化。
text_en:
Sigil of Dual Rhythm

Gradus: Fixum / Stable
Recovery Site: Layer II Twin-Key Practice Chamber

When bearer alternates left/right hand keystrokes, hourglass flow briefly slows. D-0923 reports 'hands like musicians, time as strings'. Measured effect: each hand-switch delays hourglass by half a breath.

Note: Previous user carved on wall: 'Rhythm is prayer, prayer is time'. Inscription weathered but legible.

text_zh:
圣器编号: R-1847
版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第III层废弃抄写室
描述: 黄铜齿轮组，表面刻有七种不同的圣流符文。持有者报告铭刻时'铅字间似有共鸣'。经观察，当键徒配备多种圣流类型的铭文组时，整体输出显著增强。
备注: 齿轮会缓慢自转，发出微弱嗡鸣。原理不明。D-0847表示'像是七个声音在一起唱歌'。
text_en:
Artifact Number: R-1847
Gradus: Solum
Recovery Site: Abandoned scriptorium, Layer III
Description: Brass gear assembly inscribed with seven distinct humour sigils. Bearers report 'resonance between the slugs' during inscription. Observed to amplify overall output when operators employ diverse inscription types.
Note: Gears rotate slowly, emitting faint harmonics. Mechanism unknown. D-0847 described it as 'seven voices singing together'.

text_zh:
圣器编号: R-2109
版级: 逆版 / Inversum
发现地点: 第V层机械外壳
描述: 蓝铜沙漏，内含未知流体。每四次祷击后自动翻转，依次增强基石流、共鸣流、流沙流、铅币流的输出。持有者报告'潮水在耳边涨落'。
备注: 流体颜色随周期变化：金→银→褐→绿。D-2109使用期间出现轻度时间错觉。已移交第VII层深度观察。
text_en:
Artifact Number: R-2109
Gradus: Inversum
Recovery Site: Mechanical shell, Layer V
Description: Blue-copper hourglass containing unidentified fluid. Auto-inverts every four litany-strikes, cyclically enhancing Foundation, Resonant, Hourglass, and Plumbum humours respectively. Bearers report 'tides rising and falling in my ears'.
Note: Fluid color shifts with cycle: gold→silver→brown→green. D-2109 experienced mild temporal disorientation during use. Transferred to Layer VII for extended observation.

text_zh:
圣器编号: R-0001
版级: 熔版 / Fusum
发现地点: ████ REDACTED ████
描述: 古老的铅制坩埚，内壁刻满不可识别的符文。能将任何圣流转化为纯净的铅币流。持有者报告'一切都在融化，只剩下最重的那部分'。
警告: 长期使用导致严重的圣流感知障碍。已知三例D级人员出现'万物皆铅'症状。
备注: 据传为初代守卷人遗物。真伪待查。
text_en:
Artifact Number: R-0001
Gradus: Fusum
Recovery Site: ████ REDACTED ████
Description: Ancient lead crucible inscribed with unidentifiable runes on inner surface. Converts all humours into pure Plumbum flow. Bearers report 'everything melting, only the heaviest part remains'.
Warning: Extended use causes severe humour perception disorders. Three D-class subjects developed 'universal lead' syndrome.
Note: Allegedly belongs to the founding Custodians. Authenticity unverified.

text_zh:
授权卡片: F-001-附
版级: 定版 / Fixum
签发部门: 物资分配办公室
描述: 标准征用卡片，加盖未知印章。持卡者在圣物市集购买时享受价格优惠。市集商贩对此卡片表现出异常的恭敬态度。
备注: 印章样式不符合现行条例。推测为早期时代遗留文件。鉴于仍然有效，暂不回收。D级人员反映'商贩看到卡片就点头哈腰'。
text_en:
Authorization Card: F-001-Appendix
Gradus: Fixum
Issuing Department: Material Allocation Office
Description: Standard requisition card bearing unknown seal. Cardholders receive reduced prices at Reliquary Bazaar. Merchants show unusual deference to this document.
Note: Seal pattern does not match current regulations. Presumed legacy document from earlier era. Remains effective, therefore not recalled. D-class personnel report 'merchants bow and scrape when they see the card'.

text_zh:
职务徽章: S-0847
版级: 脱版 / Solum
原持有者: Scriptor ████-████（已失联）
描述: 银质徽章，刻有'废料甄别员'字样。佩戴者在移交铭文组时获得额外铅币补偿。市集记录显示回收价格'莫名提高'。
备注: 徽章边缘有轻微磨损，疑似长期佩戴所致。原持有者笔记记录：'每一片废铅都有它的价值，关键是要看得出来'。现已重新分配给现役人员。
text_en:
Service Badge: S-0847
Gradus: Solum
Previous Bearer: Scriptor ████-████ (missing)
Description: Silver badge inscribed 'Waste Appraiser'. Wearers receive enhanced compensation when relinquishing inscriptions. Bazaar records show recycling prices 'inexplicably elevated'.
Note: Badge shows slight edge wear consistent with extended use. Previous bearer's notes record: 'Every scrap of waste lead has value - the key is learning to see it'. Now reassigned to active personnel.

text_zh:
版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第I-IV层，商位额外增生处
描述: 羊皮纸券，蜡封处印有未知徽记。持有者于圣物市集中可征用额外商品一件。经观察，该商品品质异常稳定，从未出现定版以下等级。
来源: ████████ 年M.2██起批量发现于废弃账簿间
备注: 徽记与现存任何誓门标识均不符。蜡封从未融化。
text_en:
Classification: Fixum
Recovery Site: Layers I-IV, auxiliary market stalls
Description: Parchment voucher bearing unknown seal. Bearer gains access to additional merchandise at Reliquary Bazaar. Observed items consistently exceed common grade quality.
Origin: Mass discovery in abandoned ledgers, M.2██
Note: Seal design matches no known Order insignia. Wax never melts.

text_zh:
版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第██层，废弃金库
描述: 不明材质圆盘，表面刻有财务符文。持有者于每层登临时，铅币存量自发增长。增长比例与现存数量相关。已观测最高增量为二十铅币。
附带现象: 周围偶闻算盘珠响
来源: 前守卷人████的私人保险库
备注: 符文与现行财务条例§4.2款式不符。
text_en:
Classification: Solum
Recovery Site: Layer ██, abandoned treasury
Description: Disk of unknown alloy bearing fiscal runes. Holder's lead coin reserves spontaneously increase upon each layer entry. Growth rate correlates with existing amount, capped at twenty coins.
Phenomena: Occasional abacus sounds in vicinity
Origin: Private vault of former Keeper ████
Note: Rune style predates current fiscal statute §4.2.

text_zh:
版级: 逆版 / Inversum
发现地点: 第VIII层通风管道
描述: 铜制通行证，边缘呈不规律缺口。持有者可于圣物市集中无偿征用最低价商品。商户对此交易无异议，仿若遵循某种未记录条例。
已知使用: D-████在███次使用中未遇阻拦
来源: 推测为前时代走私网络遗留
备注: 背面铭文'以汝之缺偿我之需'。语法不符现行教会拉丁语。
text_en:
Classification: Inversum
Recovery Site: Layer VIII ventilation system
Description: Copper pass with irregular edge breaks. Holder may requisition lowest-priced bazaar goods without payment. Merchants comply without resistance, as if following unrecorded statute.
Usage Log: D-████ reported ███ successful transactions
Origin: Suspected pre-transition smuggling network
Note: Reverse inscription reads 'By thy want, fulfill mine.' Grammar inconsistent with canonical Latin.

text_zh:
版级: 熔版 / Fusum
发现地点: 前拍卖厅遗址
描述: 黄铜拍卖铃，表面温度异常。摇动时启动未知计时机制，圣物市集货架可无限换新，但全部商品将在固定时间后消失。
风险评估: 三名D级人员因犹豫超时而失去征用机会
来源: 空椅时代前期拍卖厅，最后一次记录使用为M.1██
备注: 铃声频率与祷文引擎基调存在████Hz偏差。原因待查。
text_en:
Classification: Fusum
Recovery Site: Former auction hall ruins
Description: Brass bell with abnormal surface temperature. Activation triggers unknown timing mechanism. Bazaar goods may be restocked indefinitely, but all merchandise vanishes after fixed duration.
Risk Assessment: Three D-Class subjects lost requisition opportunity due to hesitation
Origin: Pre-Empty Chair auction hall, last recorded use M.1██
Note: Bell frequency deviates ████Hz from Engine fundamental. Cause pending investigation.

text_zh:
版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 训练礼拜堂
描述: 羊毛护腕，内侧缝有激励铭文。佩戴者在每层初期铭刻时报告'手指更灵活'。经测量，铭文组铸出速度确有暂时性增长。效果随时间递减。
使用记录: 新晋键徒标准配发物品之一
来源: 见习修士工坊，制作工艺已标准化
备注: 铭文内容为'初落之铅，轻于后铸'。
text_en:
Classification: Fixum
Recovery Site: Training chapel
Description: Wool wristbands with motivational inscriptions sewn inside. Wearers report 'increased finger dexterity' during early-layer inscription work. Measured inscription group output shows temporary enhancement, diminishing over time.
Usage: Standard issue for novitiate keybound
Origin: Apprentice workshops, production standardized
Note: Inscription reads 'First lead falls lighter than the last cast.'

text_zh:
🔔 沙漏停滞时，圣坛自开其库。
────
📄 编号: Stage-072
版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第III-VII层廊道
描述: 键徒报告在特定层级间歇时，圣物市集货架出现自主轮换现象。同时伴随铅币储量异常增长，增量恒定。D-████系列人员对此现象表现出强烈依赖性。
备注: 轮换机制运转时，远处传来齿轮咬合声。未发现对应机械结构。
text_en:
🔔 When the hourglass stills, the altar opens its vault.
────
📄 Index: Stage-072
Gradus: Solum / Unbound
Location: Corridors III-VII
Description: Keybound personnel report spontaneous inventory rotation in Reliquary Bazaar during inter-vault intervals. Concurrent anomalous accumulation of lead tokens observed at consistent rates. D-████ series display marked dependency on phenomenon.
Note: Gear mesh audible during rotations. No corresponding mechanical structure located.

text_zh:
🔔 掷骰者献其铅币，引擎或还以三倍。
────
📄 编号: Stage-089
版级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第IV层 休憩廊
描述: D-████报告休息时段可进行'铅币奉献仪式'。标准奉献额为一百枚，返还结果呈双态分布。成功案例获得三倍返还，失败则完全损失。奉献频率与键徒失联率呈正相关。
备注: 仪式进行时听见遥远的骰子声。第IV层未发现骰子。
text_en:
🔔 The dice-caster offers lead coin; the Engine may return threefold.
────
📄 Index: Stage-089
Gradus: Solum / Unbound
Location: Layer IV Rest Corridor
Description: D-████ personnel report availability of 'lead coin oblation ritual' during rest intervals. Standard offering: one hundred tokens. Return follows binary distribution - successful cases yield triple return, failures result in total loss. Offering frequency correlates positively with personnel disappearance rates.
Note: Distant dice rattle audible during rituals. No dice found on Layer IV.

text_zh:
🔔 汝之油壶永不见底，直至引擎索其代价。
────
📄 编号: Artifact-041
版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 机械外壳储物室
描述: 黄铜制圆筒装置，内装粘稠机油。使用后键徒报告'时间流速变缓'，实际表现为每层作业时限延长。油料消耗率极低，原理不明。已知████次使用中无一例耗尽。
备注: 定期保养记录显示内部油位从未下降。F-001征领表单已预填。
text_en:
🔔 Thy oil flask knows no bottom, until the Engine claims its price.
────
📄 Index: Artifact-041
Gradus: Fixum / Stable
Location: Shell Vault storage
Description: Brass cylindrical apparatus containing viscous mechanical oil. Users report 'slowed time flow' - manifests as extended operational duration per vault level. Oil consumption rate negligible, mechanism unknown. In ████ recorded uses, none reported depletion.
Note: Maintenance logs show internal oil level never decreases. F-001 requisition forms pre-filled.

text_zh:
🔔 引擎为其仆设下猎物，完成者得其铅币。
────
📄 编号: Protocol-156
版级: 逆版 / Inversum
发现地点: 各层走廊墙面标记
描述: 键徒报告每层出现'特殊收容指令'，要求完成额外铭刻任务。完成后自动获得铅币奖励，数量与任务复杂度相关。指令来源不明，但格式符合标准条例编写规范。
备注: §4.2未授权此类指令分发。调查中止——末席守卷人确认其合规性。
text_en:
🔔 The Engine sets prey for its servants; the successful claim their lead.
────
📄 Index: Protocol-156
Gradus: Inversum / Self-Reorganizing
Location: Wall markings, all levels
Description: Keybound report appearance of 'specialized containment directives' requiring additional inscription tasks per vault. Completion triggers automatic lead token dispensation proportional to task complexity. Directive source unknown, but formatting matches standard regulatory protocols.
Note: §4.2 did not authorize such directive distribution. Investigation terminated - final signatory confirmed compliance.

text_zh:
🔔 死者之鸟以己身为薪，燃尽方得重生。
────
📄 编号: Artifact-003
版级: 熔版 / Fusum
发现地点: [已编辑]
描述: 首次发现于D-0001失联现场。使用后键徒可从收容失败中复归，时间流自动回溯。代价为圣器自毁。执事试炼与意志显现时伴随额外市集货架轮换现象。
备注: 连续使用记录: 0。每次复归后，持有者对'再死一次'表现出病理性恐惧。F-044表单他人代填率: 0%。
text_en:
🔔 The death-bird burns itself as kindling; only through ash comes rebirth.
────
📄 Index: Artifact-003
Gradus: Fusum / Molten
Location: [REDACTED]
Description: First recovered at D-0001 disappearance site. Enables keybound recovery from containment failures via temporal reversion. Cost: total artifact destruction. Concurrent anomalous inventory cycling observed during Deacon Trials and Will Manifestations.
Note: Consecutive use record: 0. Post-recovery subjects display pathological fear of 'dying again'. F-044 proxy completion rate: 0%.

text_zh:
🔔 沙漏将倾时，铅字自碎以求其名永存
────
📄 编号: R-051「绝境暴击」
版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第VII层 废弃抄写室
描述: 时限逼近时，键徒报告铅字碎裂频率异常增高。D-████使用记录显示，压力环境下此现象尤为明显。经观察，铅字似乎在感知倒计时。
附带现象: 键座偶发微热。
处置: 标准征用。无特殊收容需求。
备注: 原理不明。Scriptor K-████曾质疑此为引擎意志显现，已按§7.1处置。
text_en:
🔔 When the hourglass empties, the slugs shatter themselves for eternity
────
📄 Item: R-051 「Desperate Strike」
Grade: Fixum
Recovery Site: Vault VII, Abandoned Scriptorium
Description: Increased fracture frequency reported during temporal pressure. D-████ usage logs confirm pattern correlation with countdown proximity. Slugs appear to sense approaching deadline through unknown mechanism.
Anomalous Effect: Lectern occasionally registers thermal increase.
Disposition: Standard requisition. No special containment.
Note: Mechanism unclear. Scriptor K-████'s theory regarding Engine awareness processed per §7.1.

text_zh:
🔔 汝之重负，护符为汝分担其苦
────
📄 编号: P-017「修饰器护盾」
版级: 定版 / Fixum
来源: 第IX层 机械外壳
描述: 佩戴时，残余异文造成的负面效应显著减弱。D-████报告「感觉轻松了些」。经████次试验，确认可稳定削弱异文干扰。
原理推测: 可能通过未知频率抵消异文共振。
使用记录: 无不良反应。偶有使用者报告听到远处机油滴答声。
备注: 第IX层回收物品均显示类似防护特性。该层用途待查。
text_en:
🔔 Thy burden shared, the ward lightens what weighs upon thee
────
📄 Item: P-017 「Modifier Shield」
Grade: Fixum
Origin: Vault IX, Mechanical Shell
Description: Worn artifact reduces negative effects from residual anomalies. D-████ reported 'feeling lighter somehow'. ████ trials confirm consistent interference reduction.
Theory: Possible resonance cancellation via unknown frequency.
Usage Log: No adverse reactions. Occasional reports of distant oil dripping audible to wearer.
Note: All Vault IX recoveries show similar protective properties. Layer purpose under investigation.

text_zh:
🔔 苦厄愈深，恩典愈厚
────
📄 编号: E-023「困境红利」
版级: 活版 / Mobilum
发现地点: 第V层 执事厅
描述: 持有者承受的残余异文负担与市集征用价格呈反比关系。经统计，每项永久修饰器使圣物市集价格显著下降。
观察记录: 市集商贩态度无变化，价格调整似为自动发生。无人工干预迹象。
理论分析: 可能触发了未记录的《市集条例》条款。
备注: 相关条例文本仍在档案室第██层，暂无权限调阅。
text_en:
🔔 The deeper the suffering, the greater the grace bestowed
────
📄 Item: E-023 「Bounty Hunter」
Grade: Mobilum
Recovery Site: Vault V, Deacon's Hall
Description: Bearer's residual anomaly burden inversely correlates with reliquary prices. Statistical analysis confirms significant cost reduction per permanent modifier.
Observation Log: Bazaar vendors show no behavioral change. Price adjustments appear automatic with no manual intervention detected.
Theory: May trigger unrecorded provisions in 《Bazaar Codex》.
Note: Relevant regulatory texts remain in Archive Level ██, clearance insufficient for access.

text_zh:
🔔 慈悲一瞬，可免终生重负
────
📄 编号: D-009「赦免状」
版级: 脱版 / Solum
来源: 末席守卷人遗物室
描述: 印有模糊印章的古老羊皮纸。持有时，意志显现期间可延迟一次修饰器选择。每次面对意志时限用一次。
历史记录: 原为守卷人议会成员所持。空椅时代后在遗物室发现。印章图案已不可辨识。
使用效果: D-████报告「有种被原谅的感觉」。
警告: 纸张在光照下呈现未知文字痕迹。内容待解析。
备注: 类似赦免状可能存在更多份，建议扩大搜索范围。
text_en:
🔔 One moment of mercy may lift a lifetime's burden
────
📄 Item: D-009 「Pardon Writ」
Grade: Solum
Origin: Last Signatory's reliquary chamber
Description: Ancient parchment bearing illegible seal. Allows bearer to delay modifier selection once per Will Manifestation encounter.
Historical Record: Originally held by Council member. Recovered from reliquary post-Empty Chair Era. Seal pattern no longer identifiable.
Usage Effect: D-████ reported 'feeling forgiven somehow'.
Warning: Parchment reveals unknown script under illumination. Content pending translation.
Note: Additional pardons may exist. Recommend expanded search parameters.

text_zh:
🔔 暂缓执行，非免于审判
────
📄 编号: B-031「修饰器屏障」
版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第V层 执事试炼室
描述: 执事试炼与意志显现期间，临时修饰器的生效存在延迟现象。观察显示需完成若干铭刻后方才显现完整效力。
测试记录: 延迟时间固定，不受键徒经验影响。期间修饰器呈「半激活」状态，铭刻座偶有微光闪烁。
理论假设: 可能为试炼机制的固有缓冲期，允许键徒适应新增负担。
备注: 此延迟曾救D-████一命。该员已按F-017提交感谢信函。
text_en:
🔔 Execution delayed, yet judgment remains
────
📄 Item: B-031 「Modifier Barrier」
Grade: Fixum
Recovery Site: Vault V, Deacon's Trial Chamber
Description: Temporary modifiers during Deacon's Trial and Will Manifestations exhibit activation delay. Observation confirms several inscriptions must complete before full effect manifests.
Testing Log: Delay period consistent, unaffected by keybound experience. Modifiers show 'semi-active' state with occasional lectern luminescence.
Theory: May represent inherent trial mechanism buffer period, allowing adaptation to increased burden.
Note: This delay saved D-████'s life. Subject submitted gratitude letter per F-017.

text_zh:
在烈火吞噬骨血时——汝之规条化为烟灰，其束缚随风飘散。
────
物编: R-███ | 版级: 熔版 / Fusum
发现地点: 第XII层 祷文引擎核心区
描述: 引擎核心区持续观测到规条残片自发重组现象。每当收容铭刻达成一定节律，既定束缚条件随机消散并重新具现。D级人员报告'感觉规则在背后窃窃私语'。
附带现象: 周围异文显现不稳定，呈熔化状流转。
备注: 该现象与引擎核心脉动同步。██████的假设已被驳回。
text_en:
When the forge consumes flesh and bone—thy ordinances turn to ash, their bonds scattered to the wind.
────
Item: R-███ | Grade: Fusum (Molten Form)
Discovery: Vault XII, Litany Engine Core
Description: Continuous observation reveals spontaneous reorganization of regulatory fragments within the core zone. Upon achievement of certain inscriptional rhythms, established binding conditions randomly dissipate and re-manifest. D-class personnel report 'feeling rules whispering behind me'.
Anomalous Effects: Surrounding glyphs exhibit unstable manifestation, flowing in molten configurations.
Note: Phenomenon synchronizes with Engine core pulsation. ██████'s hypothesis has been rejected.

text_zh:
汝之枷锁，终将为汝之冠冕——当铁链倒悬，其重量化作升举之力。
────
物编: M-███ | 版级: 逆版 / Inversum
来源: 第IX层机械深处 熔变痕迹区域
描述: 收容层启动时观测到束缚条件自发极性反转。经记录的█████次启动中，攻击性束缚有47%概率转化为增益效应，同时防护性束缚数值翻倍。持有者报告'铁链开始朝上拉扯'。
附带现象: 反转发生时，周围铅字发出低频共鸣。
备注: Scriptor K-████最后笔记提及此现象。其后失联。
text_en:
Thy shackles shall become thy crown—when iron chains hang inverted, their weight becomes lifting force.
────
Item: M-███ | Grade: Inversum (Self-Inverting)
Origin: Vault IX Mechanical Depths, Molten trace zones
Description: Spontaneous polarity reversal of binding conditions observed upon containment layer activation. In recorded █████ activations, aggressive bindings show 47% probability of converting to beneficial effects, while protective bindings double in magnitude. Holders report 'chains starting to pull upward'.
Anomalous Effects: Low-frequency resonance from surrounding slugs during reversal events.
Note: Scriptor K-████'s final notes reference this phenomenon. Subsequently lost contact.

text_zh:
纵然铅字碎裂，其根基永不动摇——汝之最末一击，仍胜过虚无。
────
物编: S-███ | 版级: 定版 / Fixum
分类: 基石流稳定装置
描述: 收容铭刻过程中，观测到基石流维持最低阈值现象。即便在严重收容震颤情况下，流量始终不低于标准单位的一定基准。D-████报告'感觉有什么在托着我的手'。
使用记录: 已知█████次部署中，未发生一例完全基石流枯竭事件。
备注: 装置来源不明。储藏室清单中无对应征用记录。
text_en:
Though the lead may shatter, its foundation never wavers—thy final strike still surpasses the void.
────
Item: S-███ | Grade: Fixum (Fixed Form)
Classification: Foundation Humour stabilization apparatus
Description: Minimum threshold maintenance phenomenon observed during containment inscription processes. Even under severe containment tremors, flow rates consistently remain above baseline standard units. D-████ reports 'feeling something supporting my hand'.
Deployment Record: In █████ known deployments, zero instances of complete Foundation Humour depletion occurred.
Note: Device origin unknown. No corresponding requisition records in storage manifests.

text_zh:
慈悲之秤偏向恩典——其天平不称罪孽之重，唯计恩赐之轻。
────
物编: J-███ | 版级: 定版 / Fixum
来源: 抄写室(第V层) 废弃审判台
描述: 收容基准评估时发现阈值系统性降低。经统计分析，基准值保持在原设定的特定比例。使用者报告审判过程'感觉更加温和'。无不良副作用记录。
观察记录: 装置周围发现陈年香蜡残迹，疑为崇拜时代遗物。
备注: 符合§4.2(b)损耗补充条例。已纳入标准配给清单。
text_en:
The merciful scale tips toward grace—its balance weighs not the heaviness of transgression, but the lightness of benediction.
────
Item: J-███ | Grade: Fixum (Fixed Form)
Origin: Scriptorium (Vault V) abandoned judgment platform
Description: Systematic threshold reduction discovered during containment baseline assessments. Statistical analysis confirms baseline values maintain specific proportional reduction from original settings. Users report judgment processes 'feeling more gentle'. No adverse side effects recorded.
Observation Log: Ancient candle wax residue found around device, suspected Worship Era relic.
Note: Compliant with §4.2(b) attrition replacement protocols. Added to standard issue manifests.

text_zh:
登顶者之杯盏——其内盛载引擎认可，饮之者得铅币如雨。
────
物编: T-███ | 版级: 脱版 / Solum
来源: 第XII层 最后守卷人座席下
描述: 战斗评估达到顶级标准时，该遗物自发产出铅币。产出量与评估等级正相关：优秀级产出基础数额，卓越级翻倍，完美级数倍增长。持有者报告杯盏'在胜利时变得温热'。
附带现象: 每次产币时，周围空气中回荡短暂钟声。
备注: 座席下同时发现未签名的F-044表单十七份。调查中止。
text_en:
The summit-seeker's chalice—within it flows the Engine's recognition, and those who drink receive coin like rainfall.
────
Item: T-███ | Grade: Solum (Unbound Form)
Origin: Vault XII, beneath the Final Keeper's seat
Description: Spontaneous lead coin generation observed upon achievement of apex combat assessments. Output correlates with evaluation tier: excellent tier produces baseline amounts, superior tier doubles output, perfect tier multiplies significantly. Holders report chalice 'grows warm during victories'.
Anomalous Effects: Brief bell tolling resonates through surrounding air during each coin manifestation.
Note: Seventeen unsigned F-044 forms discovered alongside beneath seat. Investigation suspended.

text_zh:
遗物分级: 脱版 / Solum
发现地点: 第 III 层抄写室，桌案抽屉夹层
描述: 破旧的铜质徽章，镌刻模糊。持有者完成收容任务后，征用铅币数量与其表现呈反比关系。表现越差，铅币征收额度越高。
备注: D-████ 报告"我越是搞砸，钱包越鼓"。原因不明。已记录 ██ 次异常征收事件。
附录: 徽章背面隐约可见"及格者得永生"字样。字体与第 V 层祭文不符。
text_en:
Object Class: Solum
Recovery Site: Layer III scriptorium, hidden drawer compartment
Description: Tarnished copper badge with worn inscriptions. Holders experience inverse correlation between performance quality and lead coin requisition rates. Poorer containment results yield higher monetary allocations.
Note: D-████ reported "The worse I screw up, the fatter my purse gets." Mechanism unknown. ██ anomalous disbursement events logged.
Addendum: Badge reverse bears faint inscription "The Adequate Shall Inherit." Font inconsistent with Layer V liturgies.

text_zh:
遗物分级: 逆版 / Inversum
发现地点: 第 VII 层，冷凝管道内结晶物
描述: 半透明球体，内含不断翻滚的铅屑。持有者铭刻时，每个字符的结晶流产出呈递增趋势。第一个字符产出微量，随后每个字符产出量依次攀升。
现象记录: D-████ 使用期间，周围温度下降 █℃。铅字圣坛表面出现霜花。
警告: 长期持有者报告"手指越来越冷，但心里越来越热"。建议限制使用时长。
状态: 收容中。每月更换持有者以防冻伤。
text_en:
Object Class: Inversum
Recovery Site: Layer VII, crystalline formation within cooling conduits
Description: Translucent sphere containing perpetually tumbling lead fragments. Holders experience escalating crystalline humour output per inscribed glyph. Initial characters yield minimal amounts, with each subsequent character producing progressively greater quantities.
Observed Phenomena: Ambient temperature drops █°C during D-████ operation. Frost patterns manifest on lectern surfaces.
Warning: Extended carriers report "fingers growing colder, but heart growing warmer." Usage duration restrictions advised.
Status: Contained. Monthly rotation of personnel to prevent frostbite.

text_zh:
遗物分级: 熔版 / Fusum
发现地点: [数据删除]
描述: 深黑色金属环，中心虚空。持有者铭刻时，结晶流不进入常规计量，而是积聚于未知空间。唯有按下落版键才触发结算——要么完全达标并获得丰厚铅币，要么立即引发站点污染。
现象: D-████ 报告"感觉像在喂食什么东西"。圣坛附近光线弯曲。
事故记录: ██ 次使用中，█ 次站点污染，█ 次异常丰收。
备注: 第 ██ 次事故后，发现抄写室墙壁上出现"馈赠者终得其报"字样。字迹不详。
text_en:
Object Class: Fusum
Recovery Site: [DATA EXPUNGED]
Description: Obsidian metal ring with void center. Holders experience crystalline humour accumulation in extradimensional reservoir rather than standard tallying. Press activation triggers binary outcome: complete threshold achievement with substantial lead disbursement, or immediate site compromise.
Phenomena: D-████ reported "feels like feeding something hungry." Light distortion observed near lectern vicinity.
Incident Log: Of ██ deployments, █ resulted in site compromise, █ in anomalous windfall.
Note: Following Incident ██, wall inscription appeared: "The Giver Shall Receive in Kind." Script origin unknown.

text_zh:
遗物分级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第 IV 层走廊，清洁用品储藏室
描述: 四叶草标本，夹在破损祈祷书第 ███ 页。持有者的各类铭文组在铭刻时更易引发裂铅现象。所有字符均受此影响。
观察: D-████ 使用期间，铅字圣坛发出轻微铃声。裂铅频率提升约 ██%。
来源推测: 祈祷书属于已失联的 Scriptor K-████。最后一页写着"愿好运眷顾后来者"。
状态: 标准收容。定期更换标本以防腐朽。
备注: 效果真实存在，但统计学机制不明。
text_en:
Object Class: Fixum
Recovery Site: Layer IV corridor, janitorial supply closet
Description: Four-leaf clover specimen pressed within damaged prayer book, page ███. Holders experience enhanced fracture probability across all inscription types during litany-strike operations. Universal glyph enhancement confirmed.
Observation: Subtle chiming emanates from lectern during D-████ sessions. Fracture frequency increased approximately ██%.
Origin Theory: Prayer book belonged to missing Scriptor K-████. Final page reads "May fortune favor those who follow."
Status: Standard containment. Specimen rotation scheduled to prevent decay.
Note: Effect statistically verified, mechanism unknown.

text_zh:
遗物分级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第 II 层铸字间，废铅回收槽底部
描述: 琥珀色小瓶，内含闪烁液体。持有者每次触发裂铅时，自动征收定量铅币。液体会短暂发光，随后归于平静。
机制: 每次裂铅后即刻从库房拨付铅币。来源和审批程序不详。
财务记录: 该遗物使用期间，铅币支出异常增加，但无对应申请表单。
 D-████ 证词: "每次听到铅字碎裂声，就听到叮当声。像有人在投币。"
状态: 收容使用中。财务部门要求调查资金来源。
text_en:
Object Class: Fixum
Recovery Site: Layer II typeworks, bottom of lead waste reclamation basin
Description: Amber vial containing scintillating fluid. Holders receive automatic lead coin disbursement upon each fracture event. Liquid briefly luminesces, then returns to dormancy.
Mechanism: Instantaneous treasury allocation follows each fracture. Source and authorization procedures unknown.
Financial Records: Anomalous expenditure increases during deployment periods, no corresponding requisition forms filed.
D-████ Testimony: "Every time I hear lead shatter, I hear jingling. Like someone dropping coins."
Status: Active containment. Treasury department investigating funding source.

text_zh:
🔔 以铅为引，共鸣为渠——一念动而千音起
────
📄 编号: A-0427 | 版级: 脱版 / Solum
来源: 第VII层 机械外壳 废弃配电室
描述: 铜制线路残片，表面覆盖异常铭印。持有者铭刻积诵类铭文组时，相邻位置的同类铭文组会自发激活。D-2847报告"好像有电流在键座里跳动"。经观察，确实伴随微弱蓝光闪烁。
备注: 自发激活不产生进一步连锁，原因不明。已记录████次使用，无异常事故。
text_en:
🔔 Let copper sing the litany of cascading flame——
────
📄 File: A-0427 | Grade: Solum
Origin: Layer VII mechanical shell, abandoned electrical room
Description: Corroded copper circuitry bearing anomalous inscriptions. When holder activates stacking inscriptions, adjacent units trigger spontaneously. D-2847 reported "feels like current jumping through the lectern". Blue luminescence observed during activation.
Note: Secondary cascades do not occur. Reason unknown. ████ uses logged without incident.

text_zh:
🔔 一瞬倾覆，积念归零——如洪水过山岗
────
📄 编号: A-0891 | 版级: 逆版 / Inversum
来源: 第IX层 深渠区域 洪水标记处
描述: 蓝铜制水纹铭牌。持有者激活积诵类铭文组时，积存层数瞬间消散，但范围内匹配铭文组显著增益。D-3102报告"像是把存了很久的力量一次放完"。消散过程伴随低沉水声。
备注: 增益强度与消散层数成正比。现象符合熔变誓门理论，但未发现相关人员接触记录。
text_en:
🔔 In one torrent, all accumulation drowns——
────
📄 File: A-0891 | Grade: Inversum
Origin: Layer IX deep channels, flood marker site
Description: Blue-copper plaque with water-pattern engravings. When holder activates stacking inscriptions, accumulated layers instantly dissipate, but matching inscriptions within range receive substantial enhancement. D-3102 reported "like releasing stored power all at once". Dissipation accompanied by low water sounds.
Note: Enhancement magnitude correlates with dissipated layers. Phenomenon aligns with Molten Order theories, but no contact records found.

text_zh:
🔔 其铸永不息，其音恒不歇——引擎之心亦有此韵
────
📄 编号: A-1204 | 版级: 熔版 / Fusum
来源: ████ 推测来自引擎核心泄漏
描述: 微型齿轮装置，表面温热，持续发出机械嗡鸣。持有者的积诵类铭文组不再遵循常规复归。所有积诵间隔延长但保持永续。D-4951在第30日报告"感觉键座在自己呼吸"。
备注: 装置内部结构持续变化，无法完整测绘。已指派专人监控，防止收容突破。熔版物品不应长期持有。
text_en:
🔔 Its forging knows no rest, its song no silence——
────
📄 File: A-1204 | Grade: Fusum
Origin: ████ Suspected Engine core leakage
Description: Miniature gear assembly, warm to touch, emitting constant mechanical hum. Holder's stacking inscriptions no longer follow standard reversion patterns. All accumulations slow but persist indefinitely. D-4951 reported on day 30: "lectern feels like it's breathing".
Note: Internal structure in constant flux, complete mapping impossible. Dedicated monitoring assigned to prevent containment breach. Fusum-grade items should not be held long-term.

text_zh:
🔔 鼓音传递，积念循环——汝连祷之时，余音亦起
────
📄 编号: R-0156 | 版级: 定版 / Fixum
来源: 第III层 抄写室 Scriptor V-████遗物
描述: 兽皮小鼓，鼓面有褪色铭印。持有者连祷期间，每当连击达到特定节奏，随机一处积诵类铭文组会自动增层。节奏间隔恒定，与心跳频率接近。
备注: 已归入"安全级"圣徒遗物目录。原持有者笔记显示："连祷如鼓点，一拍连一拍，直到手指记住了祷告。"
text_en:
🔔 The drum's echo carries prayer from finger to finger——
────
📄 File: R-0156 | Grade: Fixum
Origin: Layer III scriptorium, Scriptor V-████ remains
Description: Small hide drum with faded inscriptions on membrane. During holder's prayer chains, random stacking inscriptions gain layers at regular rhythm intervals matching human heartbeat frequency.
Note: Catalogued as "Safe" Sacred Artifact. Original holder's notes state: "Prayer chains like drumbeats, one stroke to the next, until fingers remember the litany."

text_zh:
🔔 词有其根，根有共鸣——完整之言乃圣流之源
────
📄 编号: R-0203 | 版级: 定版 / Fixum
来源: 第V层 抄写室 完稿区域
描述: 羊皮书签，边缘有手工缝制金线。持有者完成完整单词铭刻时，所有积诵类铭文组根据单词长度获得层数增益。现象仅在语义完整时触发，拼写错误无效。
备注: 金线在触发时发出暖光。前任持有者D-1847报告"每个完整的词都像一首小诗"。已确认对17种已知语言均有效。
text_en:
🔔 Words have roots, and roots resonate in harmony——
────
📄 File: R-0203 | Grade: Fixum
Origin: Layer V scriptorium, completed manuscript area
Description: Parchment bookmark with hand-stitched gold thread borders. When holder completes semantic word inscription, all stacking inscriptions gain layers proportional to word length. Effect only triggers with complete semantic units, not spelling errors.
Note: Gold thread emits warm glow during activation. Former holder D-1847 reported "every complete word feels like a small poem". Confirmed effective across 17 known languages.

text_zh:
圣印 · 裂铅溢流
────
编号: S-0147
版级: 定版 / Fixum
发现地点: 第IV层 废铅收集坑
描述: D-████ 报告铭刻时偶现'雷击感'，同时相邻铭文组出现异常活跃。经观察，此类事件后收容效率显著提升。附带现象：走廊内可闻微弱铜铃声。
备注: 已知████次使用中，无不良反应。原因不明。
text_en:
Sigil of Overflow
────
Designation: S-0147
Gradus: Fixum
Recovery Site: Vault IV, Lead Collection Pit
Description: Subject D-████ reported occasional 'thunderstrike sensation' during inscription, accompanied by unusual activity in adjacent inscription sets. Observed containment efficiency increases significantly following such events. Associated phenomena: faint brass chiming audible in corridors.
Note: No adverse reactions recorded across ████ documented uses. Cause undetermined.

text_zh:
圣印 · 铭涌
────
编号: S-0203
版级: 脱版 / Solum
